source_note: NYC Department of Finance, Annual Report on the New York City Real Property Tax (one edition per fiscal year). Four-class levies ($ millions) come from the class-levy history table (Table 19 'Tax Levy Distribution by Class') in the newest edition that covers each year: FY2026 edition for FY2007-2026, FY2023 for FY2004-2006, FY2022 for FY2003, FY2021 for FY2002, FY2020 for FY2001, FY2019 for FY2000. c2_rental_share = (Rentals + Conrentals + 4-10 Family Rentals) / Class 2 total, using the gross 'Tax Levy' column (before STAR and abatements; 'Tax Levy (Sch. Tax)' in FY2005-FY2018 editions) of each year's own 'Reconciliation of the Assessment Roll, Tax Levy and Net Levy Billed by Property Type' table. Owner units = co-ops, condos, condops (large and 2-10 family). Before FY2010 there is no Conrentals category; DOF says those parcels were classified as residential condos, so FY2005-FY2009 shares count rental condo buildings as owner units. FY2000-FY2004 editions have no levy-by-property-type table, so c2_rental_share is null for those years.
